matching_mechanism.field: V2Themes (GKG 2.1 column index 8; aka V2THEMES). Semicolon-delimited tokens, each optionally carrying a ',charOffset' suffix (e.g. 'TERROR,1843;ARMEDCONFLICT,55'). Use V2Themes (GKG 2.1), NOT the legacy coarser GKG 1.0 THEMES/GKGTHEMES field.
matching_mechanism.operator: REGEXP_CONTAINS(V2Themes, r'<family_re>') per category — RE2 syntax, identical to the validated Topic dictionary. Token boundaries matter: GKG tokens are UPPERCASE underscore-joined, so a bare 'WAR' substring would also hit 'WARNING'/'STEWARD'. Anchor on documented token stems (WB_2468_CONVENTIONAL_WAR, ARMEDCONFLICT, TERROR), never loose substrings.
matching_mechanism.owned_table_target: Production does NOT REGEXP raw GKG per query. Materialize ONE owned, date-partitioned sibling table qgi_gdelt.gkg_gpr_flags (alongside the live-pulse qgi_gdelt.gkg_topic_flags) with one BOOL column per GPR category (g1..g8) + gpr_any + FIPS country_code + tone, computed ONCE over raw gdelt-bq.gdeltv2.gkg_partitioned, then read cheaply forever. Do NOT widen the existing 194M-row gkg_topic_flags table (its closed partitions are immutable and already paid; widening forces a full re-scan). See build-plan §4/§5 and gpr_monthly_country.sql.

country_attribution.field: V2Locations (GKG 2.1 column index 10). Semicolon-delimited blocks, each '#'-delimited: type#fullname#countrycode#adm1#lat#long#featureID. Country code = block field index 2 (0-based), FIPS 10-4 2-letter (LE=Lebanon, IR=Iran, TS=Tunisia), NOT ISO2.
country_attribution.extract: REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(V2Locations, r'#([A-Z]{2})#') then UNNEST; a doc attributes to every DISTINCT country it mentions (Iacoviello's 'articles that also mention that country' rule). De-dup country within a doc so one article counts once per country.
country_attribution.prominence_gate: V2EnhancedLocations carries per-mention char offsets for a prominence filter, but topic_theme_patterns.json found offset<=500 drops 47% of docs (too strict). P1 uses ANY-mention (no prominence gate), matching Iacoviello; revisit only if multi-country noise breaks the r>0.9 gate.
country_attribution.fips_to_iso3: Join GKG FIPS to the answer key's GPRC_<ISO3> via the FIPS->ISO3 map in seed_live_baseline.py / v1 country_join (LE->LBN, IR->IRN, TS->TUN, BM->MMR, NI->NGA, SU->SDN, BG->BGD, AR->ARG, EG->EGY, TH->THA, VE->VEN, PK->PAK). For the full 44-country replication, BUILD the map for all 44 GPRC ISO3s from a FIPS<->ISO3 reference table — do NOT hand-type (the SQL's illustrative hand list e.g. KS/SF/SZ/GM is typo-prone and must not be trusted).

date_and_coverage.month_key: DATE (GKG 2.1 column index 1), YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Month = SUBSTR(CAST(DATE AS STRING),1,6) => YYYYMM. This is the GROUP-BY key.
date_and_coverage.prune_key: _PARTITIONTIME on gdelt-bq.gdeltv2.gkg_partitioned (TIMESTAMP, daily partitions). A DIFFERENT field from DATE; BOTH needed. ALL raw-GKG queries MUST filter on _PARTITIONTIME for cost pruning (qgi-aws-tf#807). Use gkg_partitioned, NOT the unpartitioned gkg (which has no _PARTITIONTIME).
date_and_coverage.coverage: GKG 2.1 (V2Themes + V2Locations) begins 2015-02-18, fully covering the PoC window (2015-02..2026-05) and the 2015-2019 calibration overlap.

affine_invariance_note: Iacoviello's published GPRC = raw_share / mean(1985-2019) * 100 is a positive affine transform of the raw share. Pearson and Spearman are invariant to a*x+b with a>0, so the proxy may be correlated against EITHER the raw-share export (gpr_export.xls SHAREH_CAT_* / GPRC_<ISO3>) or the reconstructed mean-100 index with identical r. No normalization-matching is required to test SHAPE. Levels remain incomparable because the corpus (GDELT machine-coded vs ~10 newspapers) and the denominator ('fraction of THIS country's coverage' vs GPRC's 'fraction of ALL articles GPR-about-this-country') differ; only within-country co-movement is comparable.

categories.name: War Threats
categories.definition: Words signaling the RISK / danger of war or military conflict generically (war risk, threat of war, military threat, geopolitical tensions near war/conflict topic words).
categories.note: gkg_themes here are all in the validated T02 dictionary (confident). They anchor the SUBJECT (war/conflict) but GDELT under-detects pure threat / sabre-rattling language with no kinetic event — it reads as foreign-policy coverage (v1 confidence 'partial'). PRECISION RISK: WB_2433_CONFLICT_AND_VIOLENCE is a very high-volume token (~118M docs); it covers generic crime/violence, not only geopolitical war threats, and will dominate the OR — kept for PoC continuity but likely over-inclusive. v2.0 verify_on_creds items MILITARY_TENSION and WAR_RISK have been confirmed NONEXISTENT in the GKG master theme list and removed. P2 mitigation under consideration (NOT in this frozen dict): a NEGATIVE-tone gate V15Tone[0] < threshold over conflict tokens to lift forward-looking threat framing, mirroring the currency-crisis tone gate in bigquery-validation-kit.sql QUERY B.

categories.name: Peace Threats
categories.definition: Threats TO peace / deterioration of an existing peace; instability short of war; breakdown of peace processes, ceasefires, ultimatums, war scares, saber-rattling against a peace baseline.
categories.note: CEASEFIRE is in the topics.json T02 gkg_themes list (a ceasefire breaking down is the canonical peace-threat). The WB_* conflict nodes are shared with cat1 — categories overlap BY DESIGN; the doc-level OR-flag per category handles double-counting. Same threat-language under-detection as cat1. PRECISION RISK: WB_2433_CONFLICT_AND_VIOLENCE (~118M docs) is a generic volume risk; UNGP_CRIME_VIOLENCE (~54.8M docs) would add even more generic noise if added — only use with a conflict co-occurrence gate. WB_2457_PEACE_OPERATIONS was the wrong node number (nonexistent); corrected to WB_2470_PEACE_OPERATIONS_AND_CONFLICT_MANAGEMENT and WB_2471_PEACEKEEPING. ANTI-CORRELATION WARNING: PEACEKEEPING and WB_2471_PEACEKEEPING / WB_2470 tokens should be treated with extreme caution or de-weighted — routine peacekeeping operations are the INVERSE of a peace threat; they are deployed AFTER a peace breakdown, so they may add recall but with a systematic lag/anti-correlation risk at the peace-breakdown detection window. If used: apply a tone-gate or de-weight these tokens in the scoring formula.

categories.name: Military Buildups
categories.definition: Arms build-ups, military mobilization, defense escalation, weapons-program tensions, troop deployments, rearmament, military maneuvers short of fighting.
categories.note: THIS IS A PRIMARY v2 TARGET — v1 explicitly flagged Military Buildups as a known blind spot ('reported as defense policy not armed conflict; add GDELT MILITARY/ARMSCONTROL families'). MILITARY is a confident core GKG theme (also in topics.json T02) and is the one token recovering the 'defense-policy' coverage v1 missed. v2.1 ADDS confirmed verify_on_creds: TAX_WEAPONS (the whole TAX_WEAPONS_* tree — present and rich with specific weapon-system tokens); SLFID_MILITARY_SPENDING (self-identified military spending); MIL_SELF_IDENTIFIED_ARMS_DEAL; MILITARY_COOPERATION. REMOVED (confirmed nonexistent): WB_2466_ARMS_AND_MILITARY_EXPENDITURE (wrong WB node, silently matches nothing), ARMS_CONTROL (standalone stem does not exist), TAX_MILITARY (FALSE-POSITIVE TRAP: only TAX_MILITARY_TITLE* exists, covering military ranks/job titles with 80M+ noise docs — NEVER include the bare TAX_MILITARY stem), MOBILIZATION (nonexistent standalone). Do NOT use TAX_MILITARY as a prefix match without the _TITLE suffix or an explicit named-unit stem.

categories.name: Nuclear Threats
categories.definition: Nuclear-weapon threats, proliferation tensions, nuclear escalation, nuclear-program brinkmanship; near risk/threat qualifiers.
categories.note: v2.1 COMPLETE OVERHAUL of this category. The old gkg_theme NUCLEAR does NOT exist as a GKG theme token (the only nuclear-related node is WB_509_NUCLEAR_ENERGY, a civilian energy theme). Replaced with three confirmed present tokens: WMD (weapons of mass destruction), WB_2503_WEAPONS_PROLIFERATION_AND_ARMS_CONTROL, and MIL_WEAPONS_PROLIFERATION. WB_509_NUCLEAR_ENERGY is listed in exclude_tokens: it is a CIVILIAN ENERGY theme that should be explicitly EXCLUDED from any nuclear-weapons detection to avoid counting reactor-construction news as geopolitical risk (apply NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(V2Themes, r'WB_509_NUCLEAR_ENERGY') alongside the positive match, or accept some civilian nuclear bleed at PoC stage). Previous v2.0 verify_on_creds TAX_WEAPONS_NUCLEAR and PROLIFERATION (standalone) are confirmed NONEXISTENT and removed. Confidence set to 'weak' — this WMD/proliferation token set captures treaty negotiations and proliferation-concern coverage but may miss raw nuclear-saber-rattling headlines that GKG codes only as foreign-policy. VALIDATION SCOPE: cat4 is validated ONLY against the global SHAREH_CAT_4 series, NOT per-country GPRC — IRN has no GPRC answer-key column, so the per-country gate is inapplicable. The previous v2.0 note about TAX_WEAPONS_NUCLEAR being the cleanest separator is MOOT: that token does not exist. Old WB node number WB_588_NUCLEAR_ENERGY was wrong (nonexistent); correct node is WB_509_NUCLEAR_ENERGY (used here only as the exclude token).

categories.name: Terror Threats
categories.definition: The THREAT of terrorism / anticipated terror attacks / terror plots, warnings, alerts (not yet realized).
categories.note: gkg_themes are the validated T03 dictionary set (good). TERROR is a stem matching TERROR/TERRORISM/TERRORIST; EXTREMIS a stem for EXTREMISM/EXTREMIST — both anchored, do not over-hit. JIHAD has been moved from verify_on_creds into gkg_themes — it appears in topics.json T03 (source B: looser, not strict-validated) and is a confirmed present, useful terror-threat token; treat it as 'topics.json-level' confidence rather than the strict validated T03 level. RADICALIZATION (v2.0 verify_on_creds) is confirmed NONEXISTENT in the GKG master theme list and has been removed. GKG conflates terror THREATS and terror ACTS under the same TERROR* tokens, so cats 5 and 8 share most tokens and separate mainly by tense/tone, not distinct themes. Validate the COMBINED terror signal (cat5+cat8) against SHAREH_CAT_5+SHAREH_CAT_8; only attempt the threat/act split if the blended terror category clears the gate.

categories.name: Beginning of War
categories.definition: Onset / outbreak of war or armed conflict (a realized act): invasion, declaration of war, country at war, war broke out, onset of conflict.
categories.note: Realized conflict events are GDELT's core strength (v1 cat6 confidence 'good'). ARMEDCONFLICT is the cleanest realized-conflict token; all gkg_themes here are in the validated T02 dictionary. PRECISION RISK: UNGP_CRIME_VIOLENCE (~54.8M docs) is very high-volume and covers generic crime/violence broadly, not only armed-conflict onset — it dominates the OR and may inflate cat6 precision. Kept for PoC continuity but flag for removal or conflict co-occurrence gating in production. cats 6+7 share the armed-conflict token core; onset vs escalation are hard to split on themes alone — validate combined (cat6+cat7) vs SHAREH_CAT_6+SHAREH_CAT_7. INSURGENCY appears in topics.json T02 (source B: looser, not strict-validated; WB_2451_REBELS covers most of it); verify on creds before including.

categories.name: Escalation of War
categories.definition: Escalation / intensification of an ongoing war (a realized act): war escalates/intensifies, military escalation, spread of the war, heavy fighting/combat, offensive.
categories.note: Well captured by the armed-conflict core (v1 cat7 confidence 'good'); shares its core with cat6. v2.1 REMOVED confirmed-nonexistent tokens from verify_on_creds: AIRSTRIKE (nonexistent standalone stem) and SIEGE (nonexistent standalone stem). KILL remains in verify_on_creds — it appears in topics.json T02 (source B: looser) but is very broad (KILLING in non-war contexts) and likely over-inclusive; gate with a conflict co-occurrence or drop. The escalation-specific tokens that would separate cat7 from cat6 (AIRSTRIKE, SIEGE) unfortunately do not exist as GKG stems — the cat6/cat7 split is not theme-separable. Validate combined (cat6+cat7).

categories.name: Terror Acts
categories.definition: Actual terrorist attacks / acts (a realized act): terrorist attack, act of terror, suicide bombing, terrorists struck/killed, named realized-attack language.
categories.note: Realized terror events well captured by the TERROR core (shared with cat5 — GKG does not cleanly tense-split). v2.1 REMOVED confirmed-nonexistent tokens from verify_on_creds: TAX_TERROR (nonexistent stem), TAX_TERROR_BOMBING (nonexistent), SUICIDE_ATTACK (nonexistent standalone). ADDED confirmed present tokens to verify_on_creds: ASSASSINATION; TAX_WEAPONS_SUICIDE_BOMBER; TAX_WEAPONS_SUICIDE_BOMB (these are the realized-act suicide-attack tokens in the TAX_WEAPONS_* tree, the correct prefix not TAX_TERROR_*); TAX_TERROR_GROUP_ (named-organization mentions — FP-safe realized-terror proxy because named terror groups appear predominantly in acts coverage). These verify_on_creds items are what let cat8 (acts) add signal beyond cat5 (threats); they are the HIGH-VALUE creds-side enumeration targets for the TAX_* tree. cat8 is empirically sparse/low-corr in the answer key (rare realized terror), so expect noisy per-category validation. Validate blended cat5+cat8 against SHAREH_CAT_5+SHAREH_CAT_8.

blended_proxy.name: QGI-GPR country proxy (8-category blend)
blended_proxy.formula: blended_share[country, month] = matched_docs / total_country_docs, where matched_docs = COUNT(DISTINCT doc_id) of docs attributed to that country/month whose V2Themes matches ANY of the 8 category families (a doc-level OR across g1..g8 = gpr_any), and total_country_docs = COUNT(DISTINCT doc_id) of ALL GKG docs attributed to that country that month (any theme / no theme).
blended_proxy.denominator_rule: total_country_docs = COUNT(DISTINCT doc_id), ANY theme — NEVER sum(category flags). Categories overlap (a nuclear-armed-conflict article hits cats 2,3,4,6 at once); a single doc-OR per category (and a single gpr_any OR across all 8) keeps the blended share bounded in [0,1]. This fixes v1's additive 2-topic share that could exceed 1 (v1 had 97 country-months with share>1.0, max 1.83).
blended_proxy.headline_validation_target: GPRC_<ISO3> (country level, the r>0.9 PRODUCTION gate per build-plan §7) and global GPR. Affine-invariant — see affine_invariance_note.

threats_acts_split.note: Mirrors Iacoviello's GPRT (Threats) / GPRA (Acts) decomposition, confirmed empirically against the answer key (sum SHAREH_CAT_1..5 ~ GPRHT r=0.9889; sum SHAREH_CAT_6..8 ~ GPRHA r=0.9994). The split is ORTHOGONAL to the subject (war/terror) collapse.
threats_acts_split.skew_expectation: v1 showed the proxy skews toward ACTS (GDELT theme-coding tilts to realized events over threat language). v2's added WMD/PROLIFERATION/WEAPONS threat-side tokens (cats 3-4) provide MODEST lift, but the threat-act skew is NOT eliminated. The realistic expectation for v2.1: tracks the Acts half (GPRA) well (empirically confirmed r=0.999); still under-detects pure Threats — modestly improved on military/weapons tokens in cat3, partially improved on nuclear via WMD/proliferation in cat4. NOTE: the 8-way category split is NOT theme-separable in GDELT. The tokens for AIRSTRIKE/SIEGE (cat6 vs cat7 distinction) and TAX_TERROR_BOMBING (cat5 vs cat8 distinction) DO NOT EXIST as GKG stems. The only validatable units are: threats (cats 1–5) vs acts (cats 6–8), and subject groupings (war+military / nuclear / terror / blended). Do NOT report per-category r as the headline metric; report only the threat-block, acts-block, and blended totals as primary validation units.

subject_groupings_for_validation.note: Because GKG themes do not cleanly separate threat-language from realized-acts within the same subject, the most robust validatable unit is the SUBJECT-collapsed grouping, validated against the answer key's per-category SHAREH_CAT_* columns SUMMED to the same grouping. The 8-way split is an exploratory stretch goal; the subject groupings and the threats/acts split are the honest primary units.

nuclear.note: Thin / IRN-centric; validate global SHAREH_CAT_4 only — most countries (incl. IRN) lack a GPRC counterpart. No per-country gate for cat4.

blended_gpr.note: The headline replication target; r>0.9 production gate applies HERE.

blended_proxy.metric_rule: State WHICH metric the reported r is on — levels-Pearson (trend-inflated DIAGNOSTIC) vs delta-Spearman (month-over-month change, the honest co-movement measure) — and do NOT silently switch (Ji-Hoon must-fix #1). The PoC PASS bar was 0.35 delta-Spearman (mean 0.4554 on ARG/EGY/THA/TUN/VEN); the v2 PRODUCTION gate is r>0.9 on the affine-anchored series per build-plan §7.

guards_carried_from_v1: Headline metric is delta-Spearman on month-over-month change; levels-Pearson is a trend-inflated DIAGNOSTIC, never the headline. State levels-vs-delta when reporting the r>0.9 gate; never silently switch.
Denominator is total_country_docs (COUNT DISTINCT doc_id, any theme), NEVER sum(category flags). One doc-level OR flag per category; a separate gpr_any OR for the blend.

Dictionary FROZEN before P2 validation — no per-country token tuning on the test window (leakage guard, build-plan §7). No country dropping (TUN kept despite being noisiest in the PoC). No window shopping.

share is bounded [0,1] here (single doc-OR per category => 0<=matched<=total), unlike v1's additive 2-topic share. Still assert 0<=share<=1 per category and 0<=blended_share<=1; any violation is a counting bug, not a clamp target.

t05 Protest / civil unrest stays OUT OF SCOPE — domestic contentious politics is a different risk family with no GPRC counterpart; including it depresses r for stable countries and spuriously inflates it where domestic turmoil co-occurs with external coverage (VEN/ARG/TUN).
The 7 PoC countries with no GPRC column (BGD/IRN/LBN/MMR/NGA/PAK/SDN) and any of the 44 that miss the per-country gate ship as 'QGI-GPR (uncalibrated)', NEVER 'GPR-validated'.

Confidence-first comms: this is a re-implementation on a DIFFERENT corpus (GDELT machine-coded vs Caldara-Iacoviello's ~10 newspapers) with a DIFFERENT normalization window (GDELT 2015+ vs his 1985-2019 baseline). Never claim it IS the GPR; always 'GDELT re-implementation, calibrated to Caldara-Iacoviello (2022)'. Pair every r with the four asymmetries (different corpus / different normalization window / threat-act skew / country-attribution mechanism) and the 5-of-12 PoC scope.

TAX_MILITARY is permanently EXCLUDED from all category token lists. Only TAX_MILITARY_TITLE* exists in GKG (military ranks/job titles, 80M+ noise documents). Using bare TAX_MILITARY as a prefix match is a false-positive trap.

The 8-way category split is NOT theme-separable in GDELT. AIRSTRIKE and SIEGE (needed to split cat6 vs cat7) do not exist as GKG stems. TAX_TERROR_BOMBING (needed to split cat5 vs cat8) does not exist. Primary validation units are: threats block (cats 1-5), acts block (cats 6-8), and subject groupings.
